indexTitle: Subjective Evaluation of Pixel Art Methods
introParagraph1:
Hello,

this application is used for subjective comparison of methods for converting images into pixel art. Pixel art is a graphical style characterized by low resolution and a visible pixelated ("blocky") structure. The images used in these evaluations were generated as part of my master's thesis focused on automatic conversion of regular images into pixel art style.
introParagraph2: In each step, two images will be displayed. Your task is to select:
introBullet2: or whether they appear approximately equal.
introParagraph3: The evaluations are completely anonymous. You do not need to complete all evaluations or all comparisons within them. You may stop the evaluation at any time and return later.
pixelArtistText: Are you familiar with pixel art or have experience creating it?
deadlineText: I would greatly appreciate completing the evaluation before May 13, 2026, so the results can be included in my master's thesis.
footerText: Tomáš Kurtin · FIT VUT · Master's Thesis 2026
evaluationInstruction: Select the image that looks better to you.
thanks: Thank you for participating in the evaluation.
